title: Preparation of CaCl2/MOF-303 composite and its dehumidification properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8867-8875
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08282F, Paper

Ying Li, Jianzhe Li, Shumeng Yin, Xiaowen Shan, Bin Tao, Shiqiang Wang
CaCl2/MOF-303 composites were prepared by impregnating CaCl2 into MOF-303, they showed large water adsorption capacity, high regenerative rate and excellent structural stability, proving a broad application prospect in the field of dehumidification.
